capabilities: Sync the vault with a GitHub repository via commit, fetch, three-way merge, and push
Run syncs automatically on a configurable timer or manually from the command palette or status bar
Preserve unresolvable merge conflicts as separate conflict-copy files
Exclude secrets and noise from the repository with a generated .gitignore
Show sync state, pending commits, and conflicts in the status bar and a sync log
extras: Desktop only (uses Node.js APIs, cannot run on mobile); requires Obsidian 1.11.4+. Renamed from the github-vault-sync id because that id was taken; existing installs need a manual folder move and re-entering the token. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Chinese documentation is available in the repository.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault backed up and synced across devices using a GitHub repository without export or conversion.

relations.evidence: Sync your Obsidian vault with a GitHub repository.
Git 2.28 or later | Located automatically, or set a path manually in the settings.

requires.name: GitHub personal access token (or system credential helper)

summary: Git-based sync that treats the vault as a Git working tree and commits, merges, and pushes it to a GitHub repository on a timer or on demand.
